paragraphs.text: Kinshala is a plane that only has appeared on the plane card Tember City featured in the Archenemy Release Event .

The plane has some African influences: the plane depicts a souq, an open-air marketplace common in Africa; inhabitants wear robes and headdresses; and its name is one letter away from the capital city of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kinshasa. Several humans and humanoids are seen doing business. One of the humanoids is masked and has reptile-like hands with three fingers. The other one has a snout.
